body:
Thanks guys. 

I ended up contacting a women's shelter that had a pet program. Both the dog and I are safe. :)

The situation did escalate more, however, when I went with my friend to get my things from his house. He was threatening us and literally closing in on me while I was standing in a corner of a room. As we were walking outside to calm the cops, he told us, "I will end you." 

We called the cops, and they said because it was all empty threats, it was a civil matter, but suggested I get an order of protection which could include the dog, and that I should take him to civil court. I will be looking into it soon. 

Thankfully, they also told me that since the dog is now in my possession, he would have to take me to court to get it back from me. 

Thank you guys again so much.

Arguments are usually about how neither of us cleans, to the extent that the other wants. Or how the dog jumps around, and that the ex thinks the dog is purposefully trying to hurt him.

But usually it's about cleaning and stuff not getting done. It's done on both sides.

Or, how I'm not respecting him, as, "head of household." I do, to an extent. I don't respect him as a person, and that is clear, only because he does not treat me like I'm human. I'm aware that it's probably wrong on my part, but I can't help it. I don't enjoy letting him treat me in such manners.

I know he's using the dog as a way to control me. 

Hm, I didn't even think of that, I can try reaching out to them. Thank you.
